svg.title: How the browser build runs
svg.desc: The browser UI thread handles the page, WebGL presentation, input and the audio worklet. The game runs in a worker (PROXY_TO_PTHREAD) with further pthread workers for the guest scheduler, resource service, sound pump and mixer, sharing memory, which needs cross-origin isolation. Disc data comes in bounded range requests of at most 1 MiB, either from the loopback launch server or, on the hosted site, from a service worker that reads the files you chose. Saves and settings live in IndexedDB under /persist.
svg.text: Inside the browser build
Shared memory between workers needs cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP); there is no single-thread fallback.
Browser tab
UI thread
page and canvas, WebGL presentation once per frame, keyboard,
pointer lock and gamepad, file-system proxy, AudioWorklet link
Workers PROXY_TO_PTHREAD
the game itself (recompiled code, software GS)
guest scheduler · resource service · sound pump · audio mixer
Blocking ISO reads and guest waits happen here, so the page
never freezes. 16 MiB disc block cache per worker.
IndexedDB /persist
cards and INI files, flushed every few seconds and when the page closes
Local launcher
Play-Browser.cmd / .sh
serves your build on 127.0.0.1 only,
checks Host and Origin, sends the
isolation headers and answers disc
range requests of at most 1 MiB.
The ISO is never preloaded or uploaded.
Hosted player
browser.html → play/
you choose the build folder and ISO;
the service worker sw.js answers
every play/ request from those local
files. The handles are kept in the
drakan-pages
database.
